message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and importance as international hubs:

| Airport | City | State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|------|-------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) | Atlanta | Georgia | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) | Los Angeles | California | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and Latin America; hub for American Airlines and United. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) | Chicago | Illinois | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; hub for United and American. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) | Dallas/Fort Worth | Texas | DFW | Hub for American Airlines; one of the largest single-runway airports. |
| Denver International Airport (DEN) | Denver | Colorado | DEN | Largest airport by land area; hub for United and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) | New York City | New York | JFK | Major hub for American and Delta; primary gateway to Europe. |
| San Francisco International Airport (SFO) | San Francisco | California | SFO | Hub for United and a key gateway to Asia. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA) | Seattle | Washington | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta. |
| Miami International Airport (MIA) | Miami | Florida | MIA | Major hub for American and a key gateway to Latin America. |
| Orlando International Airport (MCO) | Orlando | Florida | MCO | Hub for Southwest; major destination for leisure travelers. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) | Phoenix | Arizona | PHX | Hub for American; high volume of domestic flights. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) | Newark | New Jersey | EWR | Hub for United; major gateway to Europe. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) | Charlotte | North Carolina | CLT | Hub for American; growing international traffic. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport (DTW) | Detroit | Michigan | DTW | Hub for Delta; significant cargo operations. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) | Washington, D.C. | Virginia | IAD | Hub for United; major international flights. |

These airports serve as major hubs for airlines, handle large volumes of passengers, and often have extensive international connections.
